INCORRECT_DST_GROUP.desc: INCORRECT DST_GROUP FIELD IN TELEMETRY_CLIENT TABLE.

SRC_IP_INCORRECT_FORMAT.desc: Add src ip which is not in correct ip-prefix format.

DST_ADDR_INCORRECT_FORMAT.desc: Add dst_addr which is not in correct ip-port format.

DST_ADDR_IPV6.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv6 host:port.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_MULTIPLE.desc: Add dst_addr mixing IPv4 and bracketed IPv6 host:port entries.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_UNBRACKETED.desc: Add dst_addr with an unbracketed IPv6 host:port, which is ambiguous.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_NO_PORT.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv6 host but no port.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_BAD_HOST.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host that is not an IPv6 address.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_V4_EMBEDDED.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv4-embedded IPv6 host (RFC 4291 2.2).

DST_ADDR_IPV6_ZONE.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed zone-scoped link-local IPv6 host.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_TOO_MANY_GROUPS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host of sixteen groups around '::'.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_NINE_GROUPS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host of eight groups plus '::'.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_TWO_DOUBLE_COLONS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host that compresses twice.

DST_ADDR_NO_SEPARATOR.desc: Add dst_addr with two endpoints and no comma between them.

DST_ADDR_TRAILING_COMMA.desc: Add dst_addr with a trailing comma after the last endpoint.

GLOBAL_WITH_MGMT_VRF.desc: Global vrf mgmt with management VRF enabled.

GLOBAL_WITH_MGMT_VRF_DISABLED.desc: Global vrf mgmt with management VRF disabled - should fail validation.

GLOBAL_WITH_MGMT_VRF_NO_MGMT_VRF_CONFIG.desc: Global vrf mgmt with no MGMT_VRF_CONFIG at all - should fail validation.

GLOBAL_WITH_INVALID_VRF.desc: Global vrf that is neither default nor mgmt.

TWO_DESTINATION_GROUPS.desc: Subscriptions referencing two different destination groups.

DST_GROUP_SUBSTRING_OF_GROUP_NAME.desc: dst_group that is only a substring of a destination group name.
eStr: dst_group must name an existing DestinationGroup

DST_GROUP_NAMES_SUBSCRIPTION.desc: dst_group that names a subscription (and is a substring of the first list name) rather than a destination group.
eStr: dst_group must name an existing DestinationGroup

OTHERS_STREAM_MIN_INTERVAL.desc: Stream subscription to OTHERS with the smallest report_interval.

OTHERS_STREAM_DEFAULT_INTERVAL.desc: Stream subscription to OTHERS with the default report_interval.

OTHERS_STREAM_INTERVAL_TOO_SHORT.desc: Stream subscription to OTHERS with a report_interval below 1000.
eStr: A stream to OTHERS is sampled every report_interval, which cannot be less than 1000

OTHERS_PERIODIC_SHORT_INTERVAL.desc: Periodic subscription to OTHERS with a report_interval below 1000.

DB_STREAM_SHORT_INTERVAL.desc: Stream subscription to a database with a report_interval below 1000.
